body:
Hi @timkelty Thanks for opening this issue. All results should come from the engine because this is where all the counts are computed. You can do that directly in the engine. You have to procede in two steps:

* add in your records a new boolean attribute 'featured'
* configure the engine to bucket the featured records first (ordering the attribute descending)
  ![screenshot 2016-12-29 11 04 13](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/393765/21541435/99f2b312-cdb6-11e6-98a0-74bc3537ae3f.png)
